note: p5.5 performance-budget baselines (requirements.md §3). See docs/performance-budget.md for how each number is measured and how to bump it. Baseline changes must land in their own commit with the reason in the PR body.
cold_start_ceiling_note: requirements.md §3 target is < 2000 ms cold start on a 2019 mid-range physical Android. CI can only measure on an x86_64 emulator on a shared GitHub runner, which is slower and noisy, so 2500 ms is the emulator-adjusted ceiling. This measurement is informational (nightly, non-blocking) — it never blocks a merge.
